image_description: A close-up photograph of a small brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched vertically on a green plant stem. The wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is dark brown with distinct pale-ringed eyespots (ocelli). The background consists of blurred green grass and white clover flowers.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The antennae are visible extending from the head; they exhibit the characteristic thickening at the tips (clubs) typical of butterflies.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wings are dark brown. Two distinct eyespots with pale centers and rings are clearly visible on the hindwing, matching the diagnostic pattern of a ringlet.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wings held closed at rest revealing cryptic ventral patterning.

The thorax appears fuzzy/hairy, consistent with Lepidoptera anatomy.
